text: Principal Software Engineer in Cognitive Computing.
Progressed from Consultant to Senior Consultant.
Built features across aircraft flight-data applications using Java, Python, Go, and Vue.js.
Served as a senior developer on SOAR, a highly available Spring Boot and Docker application on AWS that analyzes engine performance and issues real-time alerts.
Developed an auditable data-export service to integrate platform versions, processing up to 700 reports per minute and 500,000 analytic executions per minute.
Troubleshot complex data issues across engine registration, analytic workflows, AWS services, and corporate networks to support accuracy and reliability in a safety-critical application.
Monitored and mitigated vulnerabilities in applications and Docker containers identified by Qualys, Prisma Cloud, and SonarQube.
Responded to P1 service outages, helping troubleshoot and mitigate production issues and follow up with root-cause analysis and preventive actions.
Owned product delivery from gathering client needs and estimating work through coordinating the development team and conducting client reviews.
Led development of key networking and operational components for a cloud-based 3D-printing platform, including video streaming, status monitoring, command control, and firmware upgrades.
Researched and prototyped IoT applications and cloud technologies, including AWS Lambda, Angular, React, and Firebase, to demonstrate new capabilities to the team.
Developed Java and Spring applications and provided technical leadership to the development team.
Developed prototypes and projects using modern technology in creative ways.
Designed and implemented a logging wrapper to meet strict requirements for logging output.
Coordinated movement of unit equipment from Fort Campbell, Kentucky, to Kandahar, Afghanistan, for deployment.
Served as a firefighter and lead firefighter, preparing for emergencies and leading readiness and response.
Prepared for and responded to medical emergencies.
Maintained and inventoried sensitive equipment for the unit.
Maintained the store and assisted customers.
Maintained a clean store, prepared coffee, sold baked goods, and assisted customers.
Prepared pizzas, cleaned the store, and assisted customers.
